question: Consider the experiment where the North pole of a bar magnet is moved towards a closed coil connected to a galvanometer, causing a deflection to the right. What is observed if the North pole is withdrawn away from the coil with the same speed?

options.A: The galvanometer shows a deflection to the left (opposite direction).
options.B: The galvanometer shows a deflection to the right (same direction).
